promote.closeSockets: Close open WebSockets of the old version

data.title: Data
data.description: Read this App's tables, keys and files. Nothing here can change them, and every read is recorded in the audit log.
data.adminsOnlyHint: App data may be personal. Ask an admin of this project.
data.sqlHint: One read-only statement, with a 2 second budget and 10 queries a minute.

previews.title: Previews
previews.description: Each pull request can run as its own App with its own empty data, no secrets, no outbound network and no schedules. Previews are public to anyone with the address.
previews.enable: Create a preview for each pull request
previews.approveHint: This comes from a fork. Only commit {{sha}} will run, and a later commit needs approval again.
previews.deleteHint: Its data goes with it. A new commit on the pull request creates it again.
previews.envHint: One NAME=value per line. Nothing is copied from production, and forks get this only if the approver says so.

bundle.title: Export and import
bundle.description: A bundle holds settings, environment values, data, files and sources. Secrets stay behind and must be entered again. Treat the file as sensitive.
bundle.tooLarge: This bundle is too large to download here. Use the command below.
bundle.fileHint: Without a file, this forks {{app}}. Bundles over 4 MiB need the command below.
bundle.fileTooLarge: This file is over 4 MiB. Use the command below.

rateRules.title: Rate limit rules
rateRules.hint: The first rule matching a request applies. Paths take * within a segment, ** across segments and :name for one segment.
rateRules.burst: Burst of rule {{n}} (empty for the same)

alerts.configHint: Stored settings are never shown. Leave these empty to keep them, or fill both to replace them.
alerts.deleteChannelHint: Rules sending only to it stop sending.
alerts.deleteRuleHint: Its alert history goes with it.
alerts.editRuleHint: Changes apply from the next check.
